verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each product gets an external ID and a product tax category (PTC) that determines taxability by jurisdiction, and that sellers only need one product ID per unique tax category rather than mapping every SKU, with many-to-1 mapping endpoints to associate billing-system products to Anrok product categories. However, the evidence never enumerates or names the actual taxonomy of categories (SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products) or shows a UI/workflow for developers to browse and assign categories. Missing for 10: an explicit list/definition of the standard tax category taxonomy, developer-facing documentation showing the category selection UI or catalog mapping workflow end-to-end, and independent confirmation that jurisdiction-specific taxability rules are automatically applied per category.
